Name: Auto-Stack Bait and Ammo
Author: JonathanFeenstra
Description:
[size=5][b]Auto-Stack Bait & Ammo
[/b][/size]This mod automatically adds any new bait and slingshot ammo in your inventory to fishing poles/slingshots that have the same type of bait/ammo attached, so you no longer need to do this yourself. It also works for fishing poles and slingshots in chests.

Manifest.Name: Auto-Stack Bait & Ammo
Manifest.Description: Automatically adds any new bait to fishing poles that have the same type of bait attached and new ammo to slingshots that have the same type of ammo attached.
